title: Man in Egypt Reportedly Convicted of Using AI-Fabricated Sexual Content to Blackmail Relative
summary: Egyptian news reports said a man in Damanhur created fake Facebook and Messenger accounts and used AI tools to place a female relative's likeness into fabricated sexual images and videos. He reportedly sent the material to her and threatened to circulate it unless she entered a sexual relationship with him. She notified authorities, and a court later convicted him and imposed a one-year suspended sentence.
